p07-c2-t.text:
If the true codeword is $\mathbf{c}_t$ and the received code has $e$ errors, the triangle inequality gives $d_H(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{c}_k)\ge d_{\min}-e$
For the correct row to be nearest: $e<d_{\min}-e$, i.e. $2e<d_{\min}$, $e\le\lfloor(d_{\min}-1)/2\rfloor$
Here $d_{\min}=3$, so at most 1 bit is guaranteed
